image_description: A close-up shot of a white cardboard box for 'BAND-AID' brand adhesive bandages. The box features the red 'BAND-AID' logo at the top, followed by blue text and an illustration of a beige adhesive bandage with a central pad. Below the illustration, there is additional text including '10 STERILE STRIPS'. The image appears to be AI-generated, evidenced by significant gibberish text and distorted typography.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text indicating quantity ('10 STRIPS'?) and other details is heavily distorted, with letters merging into each other and incorrect spacing. The word 'STERILE' is barely recognizable and malformed.
The perspective lines of the box do not converge logically. The right vertical edge seems to warp slightly inward, and the thickness of the box lid appears inconsistent with the base.
The cardboard texture is overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the subtle grain and imperfections of real packaging material. The lighting reflections are also unnaturally uniform.
